name: Revoke a season runner key
description: A season admin revokes any key bound to their season, whoever minted it -- a runner holding it fails its next token exchange, not its current match. A key of another season or of the platform fleet is not reachable here (404), whatever its id. Allowed after the close too: a credential should always be revocable. Answers the season's keys.

body.detail: No live key of this season has that id.

with.name: No such key of this season
